name: Project Play
one_liner: A compact music workstation with keys, sliders and a speaker, in engineering.
intro: A compact music workstation we are developing with an independent creator. It started as the creator's own 3D-printed working prototype; our engineers are turning it into a product that can be built in batches. Engineering is under way and it has not shipped yet.
